source: These representations solve different compression/interaction trade-offs. A single dense vector is maximally convenient for precomputation, but it must compress all relevant information into one point. Multi-vector approaches keep more local detail. Sparse representations preserve lexical dimensions in a learned form.
zh: 这些表示解决了不同的压缩/交互权衡。单个稠密向量可以最大程度地方便预计算，但它必须将所有相关信息压缩为一个点。多向量方法保留更多局部细节。稀疏表示以学习的形式保留词汇维度。
